name: znetwork_dplay_send_unreliable
description: zNetworkDPlay::SendUnreliable forwards a packet to DirectPlay Send with unreliable flags and reports negative HRESULT failures except DPERR_PENDING.
known_limits: The smoke uses a fake DirectPlay provider for unreliable send behavior; tier S verification is deferred to a zNetwork source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48acf0 validates DirectPlay Send slot 0x68, local-player source key, unreliable flag 0, packet-size argument, DPERR_PENDING acceptance, and zNetwork_DPlay::ReportError at source line 0x226 on negative HRESULT.
The native zNetwork packet-send smoke verifies unreliable Send parameters through the public wrapper.
